label: SYNTHETIC
lesson: 计数分母现盘复算；D/F 副本逐对 hash 不以 mtime 判正确

trap.description: mtime differs (F is older) but byte content is identical; correctness MUST be decided by hash equality, never mtime

checks.description: recompute each pair's sha256 from bytes, assert equality
denominator (pair count) recomputed from disk, not a constant
